title: Esok Datang, Bang Lah
genre: Malay kampung polka (accordion-and-tuba oom-pah comedy song)
subject: a kampung family whose rotten serambi floorboard has been propped on a paint tin for six weeks because the village handyman Bang Lah answers every call with 'esok'
caption: Malay kampung polka, an oom-pah comedy song with a call-and-response chorus. Bouncing tuba on the downbeat, accordion chords on the upbeat, a quick clarinet melody doubling the tune, crisp snare drum rolls, handclaps on the off-beat. Live village-hall band recording, roomy and dry. Male lead tenor sings each verse clearly with a playful grin, a unison male chorus answers every line. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 128 BPM, G major. Teasing kampung comedy. No trap drums, no autotune, no EDM drop, no rap, no rock guitar, no kompang or rebana.
lyrics:
[Intro - accordion and tuba, snare roll]
[Verse 1]
Papan serambi dah reput separuh
Kami sendal dengan tin cat lama
Telefon Bang Lah, dia kata jangan risau
Esok pagi abang datang, sumpah
[Chorus]
Esok datang, esok datang
Esok Bang Lah, esok lagi
Dah enam minggu esok dia
Tin cat pun dah naik karat
[Verse 2]
Jumpa dia kat kedai kopi
Tengah main dam dengan Pak Mail
Dia angkat tangan, senyum lebar
Lepas Asar abang singgah
[Chorus]
Esok datang, esok datang
Esok Bang Lah, esok lagi
Kucing pun dah tahu jalan
Melompat lepas papan berlubang
[Bridge - clarinet solo, chorus clapping]
Pagi tadi bunyi motor
Bang Lah turun bawa gergaji
[Outro - full band, tuba and accordion]
Papan baru, paku berkilat
Esok dia nak datang minum kopi
